ammonia.reason: Low NH3 from late proteolysis/deamination; dense low-moisture paste limits urease activity.

animal_barnyard.reason: Pasteurized milk and no smear flora limits p-cresol/indole/skatole formation.

bitter.reason: Washed curd removes lactose/acid, limiting hydrophobic bitter peptides despite long proteolysis.

blue_moldy.reason: No Penicillium roqueforti inoculation, no internal mould lipolysis to methyl ketones.

browning.reason: Maillard between residual galactose/free amino acids from 15-mo proteolysis on heating.

buttery.reason: Diacetyl/acetoin from Lactococcus lactis citrate fermentation retained in washed curd.

cheesy_sweaty.reason: Butanoic/hexanoic/octanoic acids from starter lipase/esterase lipolysis during 12-18 mo aging.

creaminess.reason: 36% fat with calcium-paracasein breakdown and warm mouthfeel from long proteolysis.

crumbliness.reason: Low moisture and calcium lactate/tyrosine crystals fracture curd after extended aging.

firmness.reason: Washed-cooked Gouda curd pressed and dried to ~37% moisture, hardened by 15 mo aging.

floral_honey.reason: Phenylacetaldehyde/2-phenylethanol from phenylalanine Strecker/transamination by lactobacilli.

fruity.reason: Ethyl butanoate/hexanoate from esterification of free fatty acids with ethanol during aging.

goaty.reason: Cow milk fat low in branched 4-methyloctanoic/4-ethyloctanoic goaty acids.

malty_nutty.reason: 3-methylbutanal/2-methylbutanal from leucine/isoleucine Strecker plus toffee lactones on aging.

melt.reason: Rennet-cooked washed curd pH ~5.3 retains intact para-casein that flows on heating.

mushroom_earthy.reason: No surface mould; very low 1-octen-3-ol/1-octen-3-one from linoleic acid oxidation.

oil_off.reason: Free fat release from coalesced fat globules and proteolyzed matrix on heating.

smoky.reason: Unsmoked make; no wood-smoke guaiacol/syringol deposition.

sour_vinegar.reason: Curd washing removes lactose and whey, limiting lactic/acetic acid by starter.

stretch.reason: Rennet-cooked non-pasta-filata curd lacks aligned demineralized fibers for stretching.

sulfur_cooked.reason: Light cooking and pasteurization give low methanethiol/DMS from methionine catabolism.

sweet.reason: Toffee/caramel delta-lactones plus sweet amino acids Pro/Gly/Ala from 15-mo proteolysis.

umami.reason: Glutamate accumulation from Lactococcus/Lactobacillus peptidase proteolysis during maturation.
